[id 190]
John collects peaches for 3 hours. He collects at a rate of 2 peaches per minute.
3 hours = $3 \times 60 = 180$ minutes.
Total peaches = $180 \text{ minutes} \times 2 \text{ peaches/minute} = 360$.

[id 191]
Ducks need 3.5 pounds of insects each week per duck.
There are 10 ducks.
Total per week = $10 \times 3.5 = 35$ pounds.
Pounds per day = $35 / 7 = 5$ pounds.

[id 192]
Net change per year = $10 \text{ planted} - 2 \text{ chopped} = 8$ trees.
Over 10 years, net growth = $10 \times 8 = 80$ trees.
Starting trees = 50.
Total before death = $50 + 80 = 130$ trees.
30% die = $0.30 \times 130 = 39$ trees.
Trees left = $130 - 39 = 91$.

[id 193]
Friday: 18 pink flamingos.
Saturday: Removed $1/3$ of 18 = 6. Painted white (6 white). Remaining pink = 12.
Sunday: Added 18 pink. Total pink = $12 + 18 = 30$. White remains 6.
Difference = $30 - 6 = 24$.

[id 194]
Cost of 5 crayons at $2 each = $10.
Budget = $20.
Change = $20 - 10 = 10$.

[id 195]
Cost of pen = Cost of pencil + Cost of eraser = $1.20 + $0.30 = $1.50.
Cost of 8 pens = $8 \times 1.50 = 12$.

[id 196]
Total carrots needed = $40 \text{ restaurants} \times 2 \text{ pounds} = 80$ pounds.
Unused = $200 - 80 = 120$ pounds.

[id 197]
Total population = 23,786.
Men + Women = $8,417 + 9,092 = 17,509$.
Children = $23,786 - 17,509 = 6,277$.

[id 198]
Initial: 20.
Month 1 collected: $3 \times 20 = 60$. Total: 80.
Month 2 collected: $60 - 20 = 40$. Total: $80 + 40 = 120$.
Month 3 collected: $2 \times (60 + 40) = 200$. Total: $120 + 200 = 320$.

[id 199]
Total sentences = 1000. Equal split = 500 per publisher.
Publisher A pays 5 cents per sentence = $500 \times 5 = 2,500$ cents.
Publisher B pays $2 \times 5 = 10$ cents per sentence = $500 \times 10 = 5,000$ cents.
Total earnings in cents = $2,500 + 5,000 = 7,500$.
